invariant: Java's DescriptionDiagramFactory owns the complete CommandCreateElementFull symbol vocabulary. Rust splits that family into Component and Deployment models, so subtype selection must choose Deployment whenever the complete source contains a valid DESCRIPTION leaf that the Component parser cannot consume. In the current model, card, stack, file, and agent are DESCRIPTION-only leaf symbols; artifact and storage remain valid Component leaves. A component declaration elsewhere cannot revive a Component candidate that failed to consume the exclusive leaf.
causal_divergence: Rust scores each component declaration at 15 and each deployment keyword leaf at 5. A document containing artifact, component, and file therefore selects UmlSubtype::Component even though the Component parser has no file command. The file line is dropped, a later link auto-creates an interface, and the artifact/component are rendered through the wrong style ownership path. The rejected deployment Fashion held-out is a dispatch failure before its renderer model is reached, not a StyleCascade precedence failure.
planned_change: Track DESCRIPTION-only leaf commands by the parser capability boundary and make Deployment win over Component when one occurs, while retaining existing Class factory viability and allowmixing rules. Add parser tests proving card/stack/file/agent force the Deployment model even beside components, while artifact/storage controls remain Component. Do not key on labels, style values, or link topology.
